name: atc
description: Coordinate exclusive Android emulator (AVD), iOS Simulator, and physical device leases across concurrent coding agents with the atc CLI, PreToolUse/SessionEnd hooks, and stdio MCP server.
suggestedPrompts: Claim an API 36 phone emulator and an iOS 18 simulator, then run KMP verification.
Check available Android and iOS devices and active leases with atc status.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate exclusive Android Virtual Device (AVD), iOS Simulator, and physical USB/Wi-Fi device leases across concurrent coding agents with profile matching, QEMU and APFS snapshots, bounded-window warm-affinity queueing, host RAM/disk guardrails, and scoped atc exec heartbeats.
capabilities: Claim and release exclusive Android and iOS emulator, simulator, or physical device leases
Run adb, simctl, devicectl, xcodebuild, Gradle, and android CLI commands with lease heartbeats
Save, restore, and reset QEMU and APFS device snapshots
Enforce multi-agent guardrails and warm-affinity queueing
defaultPrompt: Claim an API 36 phone emulator and an iOS 18 simulator, then run KMP verification.
Check available Android and iOS devices and active leases with atc status.
